title: Pokémon the Series: Black & White
synopsis: This begins with only Ash Ketchum, who sets out to travel through the Unova region and challenge the Unova League with his Pikachu, accompanied by a girl by the name of Iris and with one of the first Unova Gym Leaders, Cilan, who is also a Pokémon Connoisseur. As before, Ash receives a change of clothes. This series includes BW, Rival Destinies & Adventures in Unova and Beyond arcs
